teaching.en: The meeting links bottles left by visitors to 85 discarded bottles each weekend. Residents want clean paths, while the café is concerned about cost. The group agrees to install two £600 refill points by 1 June, with the park and café responsible. If the points are installed, bottle waste may fall, but the result is not guaranteed. Staff will count discarded bottles for six weekends and compare the figures with the current baseline. This viable agreement records the cause, effect, different positions, shared action, responsible actors, deadline and measurable indicator.

prompt.es: Resuelve la reunión escolar en 90–120 palabras.

answer.text: Thirty-two cars wait with engines running outside the school, which worsens local air. Parents prioritise cleaner air; however, drivers need a place for brief waits. The agreed measure is a signed no-idling zone costing no more than £300. The school will install it by 15 May. If the zone is signed and its signs are made visible, engine idling may fall without promising a complete end. Staff will compare idling-car counts across four mornings before and after installation. This comparison will test the measure against the documented baseline. The final record names the cause, effect, viewpoints, responsible school, deadline and practical follow-up measure.
accepted: Thirty-two cars wait with engines running outside the school, which worsens local air. Parents prioritise cleaner air; however, drivers need a place for brief waits. The agreed measure is a signed no-idling zone costing no more than £300. The school will install it by 15 May. If the zone is signed and its signs are made visible, engine idling may fall without promising a complete end. Staff will compare idling-car counts across four mornings before and after installation. This comparison will test the measure against the documented baseline. The final record names the cause, effect, viewpoints, responsible school, deadline and practical follow-up measure.

The school meeting identifies idling engines as the cause of poorer air and records 32 waiting cars. Parents want cleaner air, while drivers need a short waiting option. The school agrees to create and sign a no-idling zone by 15 May within the £300 budget. If the zone is signed and clearly marked, idling may decrease. The result remains limited. The school is responsible, and staff will count idling cars for four mornings before and four mornings after the change. These counts provide a clear baseline and follow-up comparison. The comparison will show whether the local measure is working. This agreement recognises both positions and records a viable action, condition, limited effect, deadline and measurable indicator.

feedback.es: The response recognises positions and records a measurable school agreement.

feedback.es: The traders association owns installation and emptying.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige el plazo confirmado.

origin.audio: The cardboard cage will be installed by the thirtieth of April.

prompt.es: Recupera el acuerdo del mercado en 90–120 palabras.

answer.text: The market records 40 cardboard boxes reaching the street each Saturday because shops leave them beside bins. Shop owners need convenient collection, while residents want cleaner streets. The group agrees on a £450 cardboard cage, managed by the traders association and installed by 30 April. If the cage is installed and emptied regularly, street waste may fall. The association will count loose boxes for eight Saturdays and compare them with the current baseline. This negotiated record keeps both priorities visible and confirms a viable action, responsible actor, deadline, limited effect and measurable indicator.
accepted: The market records 40 cardboard boxes reaching the street each Saturday because shops leave them beside bins. Shop owners need convenient collection, while residents want cleaner streets. The group agrees on a £450 cardboard cage, managed by the traders association and installed by 30 April. If the cage is installed and emptied regularly, street waste may fall. The association will count loose boxes for eight Saturdays and compare them with the current baseline. This negotiated record keeps both priorities visible and confirms a viable action, responsible actor, deadline, limited effect and measurable indicator.

Boxes left beside market bins create 40 loose boxes in the street every Saturday. Residents prioritise cleanliness, while shops need an easy collection process. The agreed response is a cardboard cage costing £450. The traders association will install it by 30 April and arrange emptying. If both steps are completed, loose-box numbers may decrease. The association will count boxes across eight Saturdays and compare them with the current baseline to test the change. This agreement recognises each position and states the documented cause, effect, practical action, owner, deadline and follow-up indicator without guaranteeing success.

feedback.es: The recovery uses different actors, waste, budget and follow-up.
